today.label: 01 / MAKE TODAY COUNT
today.title: Don't just know what. Know why.
today.desc: Head out with a clear distance, target pace and effort level. Every session is broken into warmup, main work and cooldown — with the purpose behind it.
today.b1t: A clear session, from start to finish
today.b1d: See the structure before you lace up.
today.b2t: Your effort belongs in the story
today.b2d: Log RPE, completion and how the run felt.
today.whyText: Tempo runs increase your lactate threshold, allowing you to sustain a faster pace for longer without building up excessive muscle fatigue.
today.caption: Product preview · Illustrative athlete data

plan.label: 02 / THE WEEK HAS A RHYTHM
plan.desc: Easy days, tempo sessions, intervals and long runs, all in one weekly view. Look ahead to the next training block and understand when it's time to taper.
plan.tipT: Coaching Tip: The Science of Tapering
plan.tipD: Understand why reducing volume in the final weeks gives recovery its place in your race preparation.
plan.caption: Product preview · Illustrative athlete data

progress.label: 03 / SEE THE WORK ADD UP
progress.desc: Distance tells one part of the story. Follow volume and pace over time, then look at adherence and intensity to understand the shape of your training.

activities.label: 04 / EVERY SESSION HAS A STORY

faq.label: BEFORE YOU HEAD OUT
faq.title: A few things to know.
faq.q1: Do I need a Strava account?
faq.a1: Yes. PacePilot uses Strava as its only sign-in method. You'll continue to Strava to sign in and review the connection permissions.
faq.q2: What can I see in PacePilot?
faq.a2: Your daily workout, weekly training plan, progress analytics, activity history and goals — connected through one running-focused workspace.
faq.q3: Are these results from real athletes?
faq.a3: The workouts, charts and records shown on this page are illustrative product examples, not performance claims or expected results.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataD: Training data (profile, activities, feedback) is used only to build your coaching plan. Strava tokens never leave the server.
settings.rgpd: Your rights under the GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679): access, correct or erase your data anytime. Disconnect stops all collection.
settings.delD: Permanently erases your athlete profile, all activities and all feedback. Cannot be undone.
settings.aboutD: Adaptive running coach — Strava supplies the evidence, the training engine decides, the coach explains.

p.title: Privacy Policy
p.s1p: Your Strava profile (name, photo), activities (distance, pace, heart rate, elevation) and your training feedback (RPE, notes). Nothing else.
p.s2p: Solely to build your adaptive coaching plan and show your progress. No advertising, no sale, no sharing with third parties.
p.s3p: Activities and profile data live in our MongoDB database. Strava access tokens are encrypted and never leave the server.
p.s4p: Access, correct or erase your data anytime. Disconnect stops all collection; Settings → Delete my account permanently erases your athlete profile, activities and feedback.
p.s5p: Data is kept while your account exists and deleted immediately when you erase it. Revoking Strava access stops future syncs.

t.title: Terms of Service
t.s1p: PacePilot turns your Strava history into an adaptive running plan. A Strava account and connection are required to use it.
t.s2p: Training guidance is evidence-based but generic. It is not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Consult a professional for injuries or health conditions. Train at your own risk.
t.s3p: Connect only your own Strava account. Do not abuse sync or share sessions to scrape data.
t.s4p: Provided as-is, without uptime guarantees. The service depends on Strava API availability and rate limits.
t.s5p: Disconnect anytime to stop collection, or erase everything via Settings → Delete my account.
